claim: RmlUi 6.3 snaps box edges to whole pixels by rounding each edge, so a 1 dp tall box (a rule drawn as a filled div) vanishes when the dp ratio is below 1 and the box lands on a half pixel: at 1080p x 85 % (dp 0.85) the first of five 1 dp rules in the host test drew nothing, the other four drew one solid pixel row. A 1 dp border keeps at least one pixel at every ratio (boxes passed at 0.85). Design rule for J34: draw hairlines as borders, never as 1 dp boxes
